extra_vocab.en: the last day or time to finish something
extra_vocab.note: 多益最常見的商務名詞之一，指報告、報名、付款或專案的最後期限，常和 meet、miss、extend 搭配。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: deadline 後面常接 for + 名詞，或 to + V：the deadline for the report、the deadline to apply。

example.en: We have three deadlines to meet this month.
example.zh: 我們這個月有三個截止期限要趕。

example.en: We worked overtime to meet the deadline.
example.zh: 我們加班以趕上期限。

example.en: Sorry, I missed the deadline for the budget report.
example.zh: 抱歉，我錯過了預算報告的期限。

example.en: Can you extend the deadline by two days?
example.zh: 你可以把期限延長兩天嗎？

example.en: The team is working under a tight deadline this week.
example.zh: 團隊這週在很緊迫的期限下工作。

examples.en: The project deadline is next Friday, so we must hurry.
examples.zh: 專案截止日是下週五，所以我們得加快。

examples.en: Please send me the final draft before the deadline.
examples.zh: 請在截止日前把最終版本寄給我。

examples.en: The supplier asked us to confirm the order by the deadline.
examples.zh: 供應商要求我們在期限前確認訂單。

examples.en: The deadline for job applications has been moved to May 10.
examples.zh: 求職申請的截止日已改到五月十日。

similar.diff: due date 多指帳款、作業的到期日；deadline 強調最後期限，過了就會有後果。

example.en: The due date on this invoice is March 15.
example.zh: 這張發票的到期日是三月十五日。

example.en: Our schedule is full until the end of June.
example.zh: 我們的行程到六月底都排滿了。

example.en: A delay in shipping may cause us to miss the date.
example.zh: 出貨延遲可能讓我們趕不上日期。

extra_vocab.en: to make a place look nice by adding things to it
extra_vocab.note: 多益常出現在公司活動、開幕、節慶布置或辦公室整修的情境，指用物品讓場地更好看。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: decorate A with B：用 B 裝飾 A，with 後面接用來裝飾的東西，例如 decorate the hall with flowers。

example.en: Our designer decorates the store window every season.
example.zh: 我們的設計師每一季都會布置商店櫥窗。

example.en: The staff decorated the lobby for the anniversary party.
example.zh: 員工為週年派對布置了大廳。

example.en: We are decorating the meeting room for the guests.
example.zh: 我們正在為來賓布置會議室。

example.en: They plan to decorate the office before the new year.
example.zh: 他們打算在新年前布置辦公室。

example.en: The hotel decorated the dining hall with fresh flowers.
example.zh: 飯店用新鮮的花布置了餐廳大廳。

examples.en: Could you help us decorate the room for the party?
examples.zh: 你可以幫我們布置派對的房間嗎？

examples.en: The shop was decorated in red for the grand opening.
examples.zh: 商店為了盛大開幕布置成紅色。

examples.en: We hired a company to decorate our new office.
examples.zh: 我們請了一家公司來裝潢新辦公室。

confusable.diff: renovate 是整修、翻新建築或空間的結構；decorate 只是用物品或油漆讓它變好看。

example.en: The company will renovate the old building next year.
example.zh: 公司明年會整修那棟舊大樓。

example.en: Please arrange the chairs before the meeting starts.
example.zh: 請在會議開始前把椅子擺好。

derived.link: decorate 去掉 e + -ion，把「裝飾」變成名詞，像 invite → invitation
decorate + -ive，有「裝飾性質的」意思，像 active、creative

senses.en: to add things to make a place look nice

example.en: The staff will decorate the hall with balloons.
example.zh: 員工會用氣球布置大廳。

senses.en: to paint or put paper on the walls of a room
senses.distinguish: 後面接 room、office，且提到油漆或壁紙時，指的是裝潢施工。

example.en: We need to decorate the new office before moving in.
example.zh: 我們搬進去前得先把新辦公室裝潢好。

extra_vocab.en: something added to make a place look nice
extra_vocab.note: 指布置用的物品或裝飾這件事，常見於活動、節慶、開幕與辦公室布置的情境。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: 指「裝飾品」時是可數名詞（a decoration、decorations）；指「裝飾、布置」這件事時不可數，如 interior decoration。

example.en: The decorations for the party arrived this morning.
example.zh: 派對用的裝飾品今天早上送到了。

example.en: We put up decorations in the lobby on Monday.
example.zh: 我們週一在大廳掛上了裝飾。

example.en: The mall sells holiday decorations at half price.
example.zh: 購物中心以半價販售節慶裝飾品。

example.en: She runs a small company for interior decoration.
example.zh: 她經營一家小型室內裝潢公司。

examples.en: Who is in charge of the decorations for the dinner?
examples.zh: 晚宴的裝飾由誰負責？

examples.en: We ordered new decorations for the store window.
examples.zh: 我們為店面櫥窗訂了新的裝飾品。

examples.en: The simple decoration makes the cafe feel warm.
examples.zh: 簡單的裝飾讓這家咖啡館感覺很溫暖。

similar.diff: ornament 多指小型的擺飾；decoration 的範圍較廣，包含整體布置。

example.en: A small ornament sat on the reception desk.
example.zh: 接待櫃台上放著一個小擺飾。

example.en: The design of the new lobby looks very modern.
example.zh: 新大廳的設計看起來很現代。

derived.link: decoration 去掉 -ion 就是動詞 decorate，像 invitation → invite
decorate + -ive，有「裝飾性質的」意思，像 active、creative

senses.en: a thing used to make a place look nice

example.en: We stored the old decorations in the warehouse.
example.zh: 我們把舊的裝飾品存放在倉庫裡。

senses.en: the act of making a place look nice
senses.distinguish: 不可數，通常指裝飾這件事本身，而不是某個物品。

example.en: Decoration of the hall will take about two hours.
example.zh: 布置大廳大約需要兩個小時。

extra_vocab.en: strong effort and time given to a job or goal
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於表揚員工、感謝團隊或介紹退休同事的情境，帶有正面、肯定的語氣。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: dedication to 的 to 是介系詞，後面接名詞或 V-ing，不接原形動詞：dedication to customer service。

example.en: Their dedications to the project were praised by the CEO.
example.zh: 他們對專案的付出受到執行長讚揚。

example.en: New staff should show dedication from the first day.
example.zh: 新員工應該從第一天就展現敬業精神。

example.en: Her dedication to quality made our products popular.
example.zh: 她對品質的投入讓我們的產品很受歡迎。

example.en: We would like to thank everyone for their dedication.
example.zh: 我們要感謝每個人的付出。

examples.en: Mr. Lee received an award for his dedication to the company.
examples.zh: 李先生因對公司的奉獻獲得獎項。

examples.en: Thank you for your hard work and dedication this year.
examples.zh: 謝謝你今年的努力與付出。

examples.en: The dedication of the new library will be held on Friday.
examples.zh: 新圖書館的落成啟用典禮將在週五舉行。

similar.diff: commitment 強調承諾與責任；dedication 強調投入大量時間與心力。

example.en: The team showed strong commitment to the deadline.
example.zh: 團隊對期限展現了強烈的承諾。

example.en: We value your commitment to our customers.
example.zh: 我們重視你對客戶的投入。

derived.link: dedication 去掉 -ion 變動詞，像 decoration → decorate

senses.en: hard work and time given to something you care about

example.en: We admire her dedication to helping our clients.
example.zh: 我們欣賞她對協助客戶的投入。

senses.en: a ceremony to open a new building or place
senses.distinguish: 後面接 ceremony，或前面有 new building、library 等地點時，指的是啟用典禮。

example.en: The mayor will attend the dedication of the new park.
example.zh: 市長會出席新公園的落成儀式。

extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於員工福利與醫療保險的情境，如牙科保險、牙醫診所預約，只放在名詞前面使用。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: dental 是形容詞，只放在名詞前面（dental care），不能單獨說「I have dental」。

example.en: Our company offers dental insurance to all full-time staff.
example.zh: 我們公司提供全職員工牙科保險。

example.en: The dental clinic is on the second floor.
example.zh: 牙醫診所在二樓。

example.en: I have a dental checkup on Tuesday morning.
example.zh: 我週二早上要做牙齒檢查。

examples.en: The new plan covers medical and dental costs.
examples.zh: 新方案涵蓋醫療與牙科費用。

examples.en: I need to leave early for a dental appointment.
examples.zh: 我需要提早離開去看牙醫。

examples.en: Please send your dental care claims to the HR office.
examples.zh: 請把牙科照護的申請單送到人資辦公室。

confusable.diff: 拼法和發音很像，但 mental 是「心理的、精神的」，dental 是「牙齒的」。

example.en: The plan also covers mental health services.
example.zh: 這個方案也涵蓋心理健康服務。

example.en: Medical costs are covered by the company plan.
example.zh: 醫療費用由公司方案負擔。

example.en: Please check your insurance before you visit the doctor.
example.zh: 看醫生前請先確認你的保險。

derived.link: dent（牙）+ -ist，做某種專業的人，像 artist、tourist
dentist + -ry，表示這個專業領域，像 dentist 的行業

extra_vocab.en: to destroy a building on purpose
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於都市重建、建築工程與新聞報導，指把舊建築拆掉，通常是有計畫的行動。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: demolish 是及物動詞，後面直接接被拆的東西，不加介系詞：demolish the building。

example.en: The city demolishes unsafe buildings every year.
example.zh: 市政府每年都拆除不安全的建築。

example.en: The old factory was demolished last month.
example.zh: 那間舊工廠上個月被拆除了。

example.en: The crew is demolishing the wall this afternoon.
example.zh: 施工人員今天下午要拆除那面牆。

example.en: They plan to demolish the building and build a mall.
example.zh: 他們計畫拆掉這棟建築，蓋一座購物中心。

collocations.phrase: be demolished to make way for

example.en: The shops were demolished to make way for a new road.
example.zh: 那些店面被拆除，好為新道路讓路。

examples.en: The company will demolish the old warehouse in May.
examples.zh: 公司將在五月拆除舊倉庫。

examples.en: The council voted to demolish the empty office tower.
examples.zh: 市議會投票決定拆除那棟空置的辦公大樓。

similar.diff: tear down 是口語、日常的說法；demolish 比較正式，常用在新聞與工程文件。

example.en: They will tear down the old garage next week.
example.zh: 他們下週會拆掉那間舊車庫。

similar.diff: destroy 指破壞到無法使用，可以是意外或故意；demolish 通常是有計畫的拆除。

example.en: The fire destroyed most of the warehouse.
example.zh: 那場火災毀掉了大部分的倉庫。

example.en: The firm will construct a new bridge next year.
example.zh: 這家公司明年會建造一座新橋。

derived.link: demolish 去掉 -ish + -ition，把「拆除」變成名詞

extra_vocab.en: related to one department in a company
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於公司內部通知與會議安排，形容部門層級的事務，如部門會議、部門預算。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: departmental 是形容詞，只放在名詞前面：a departmental meeting；要說「在部門裡」請用 in the department。

example.en: The departmental meeting starts at ten tomorrow.
example.zh: 部門會議明天十點開始。

example.en: We must keep costs under the departmental budget.
example.zh: 我們必須把成本控制在部門預算內。

example.en: Please ask your departmental manager to approve the request.
example.zh: 請請你的部門經理核准這份申請。

examples.en: All departmental reports are due by the end of the week.
examples.zh: 所有部門報告需在本週結束前繳交。

examples.en: I will share the departmental schedule with the team.
examples.zh: 我會和團隊分享部門時程表。

confusable.diff: 拼法與字尾很像，但 apartment 是「公寓」，departmental 是「部門的」。

example.en: The company rents an apartment for visiting staff.
example.zh: 公司為來訪的員工租了一間公寓。

example.en: She works in the sales division of our company.
example.zh: 她在我們公司的業務部門工作。

derived.link: 最基礎的字，de-（離開）+ part（部分），像 part 分開的意思
depart + -ment，把動作變成名詞，像 pay → payment

extra_vocab.en: the act of leaving a place
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於機場、車站與出差情境，指班機或列車的出發；也可指員工離職。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: 「離開某地」可寫 departure from + 地點；「出發去某地」是 departure for + 地點。departure 是名詞，動詞是 depart。

example.en: The board shows all departures for this evening.
example.zh: 看板顯示今晚所有的出發班次。

example.en: Please check the departure time on your ticket.
example.zh: 請確認你機票上的出發時間。

example.en: The departure gate for Flight 52 has changed.
example.zh: 52 號班機的登機門已更改。

example.en: What is your departure date for the business trip?
example.zh: 你出差的出發日期是哪一天？

example.en: Early departure from the meeting requires permission.
example.zh: 提早離開會議需要獲得許可。

examples.en: Our departure was delayed by one hour because of rain.
examples.zh: 因為下雨，我們的出發延後了一小時。

examples.en: Please arrive at the airport two hours before departure.
examples.zh: 請在出發前兩小時抵達機場。

examples.en: Mr. Chen's departure will leave an open position in sales.
examples.zh: 陳先生的離職會讓業務部出現一個空缺。

confusable.diff: depart 是動詞，departure 是名詞，兩者意思相近但詞性不同。
confusable.usage: depart 是動詞（The train departs at six.），departure 是名詞（The departure is at six.），不能互換。

example.en: The train will depart from Platform 3 at noon.
example.zh: 火車將在中午從三號月台出發。

example.en: Our arrival time in Tokyo is 9 a.m.
example.zh: 我們抵達東京的時間是早上九點。

example.en: Your flight to Seattle leaves at seven tonight.
example.zh: 你飛往西雅圖的班機今晚七點起飛。

example.en: Please wait at gate 12 until boarding begins.
example.zh: 請在 12 號登機門等候直到開始登機。

derived.link: departure 去掉 -ure 就是動詞 depart，像 failure → fail
depart + -ment，把動作變成名詞，像 pay → payment
department + -al，變成形容詞，像 education → educational

senses.en: the time when a plane, train, or bus leaves

example.en: Flight departure has been moved to gate 8.
example.zh: 班機出發已改到 8 號登機門。

senses.en: the act of leaving a job or a company
senses.distinguish: 前面出現人名、job 或 company 時，指的是離職而不是班機出發。

example.en: After her departure, we need a new sales manager.
example.zh: 她離職後，我們需要一位新的業務經理。

senses.en: a change from the usual way of doing things
senses.distinguish: 常寫成 a departure from，指與以往做法不同。

example.en: This plan is a big departure from our old strategy.
example.zh: 這個計畫與我們舊的策略有很大的不同。
